contracts.intent: Expose the DriftLock command surface for install, extraction, context, checks, coverage, diffs, explanations, acceptance, and bundled skills.

must_not_change: Commands must read .drift/config.json before falling back to defaults.
Extract must remain the only command that writes the committed contract index.
--git-base must only be accepted together with --changed on check.

contracts.intent: Install DriftLock into a target project by creating managed config, scripts, dependency instructions, optional ESLint config, CI, skills, and examples.

must_not_change: Dry runs must report planned changes without writing project files.
Managed files must not overwrite existing files unless force is enabled.
Installer-generated projects must keep using a simple single-source config.

contracts.intent: List and install bundled DriftLock agent skills with provider-specific file layout and command templating.

must_not_change: Unknown requested skills must fail instead of being silently ignored.
Existing installed skills must require force before replacement.
Provider-specific filtering must preserve OpenAI, Claude, and Cursor layouts.

contracts.intent: Validate extracted Drift contracts against executable invariants, required-file coverage, and locked-contract baselines.

must_not_change: Locked contracts must compare against the committed index before passing.
Required contract checks must use the configured source files.
Schema extraction errors must not prevent valid contracts from being checked.

contracts.intent: Define and validate the DriftLock project config schema used by every CLI command.

must_not_change: Preserve default config compatibility for projects without .drift/config.json.
Keep config validation strict so ignored fields cannot look enforceable.

contracts.intent: Build the default DriftLock config from the shared default index path so CLI defaults cannot drift away from index-file behavior.

must_not_change: Default config index must come from defaultIndexPath.
Missing config files must keep using enforce adoption mode.

contracts.intent: Render concise Drift contract context for a target file or task so agents can plan edits against declared constraints.

must_not_change: File context must stay scoped to the requested file.
Task context must rank contracts from ids, files, intents, SSOT, invariants, and LLM notes.
Planning notes must continue telling agents to run diff and check after edits.

contracts.intent: Compare current Drift contracts with the committed index and format reviewer summaries for intentional contract changes.

must_not_change: Diff output must distinguish added, changed, and removed contracts.
Locked contract acceptance files must require a valid contract id and reason.
Git-scoped diffs must not report unrelated indexed contracts.

contracts.intent: Report DriftLock adoption coverage across contracts, required files, executable invariants, and visible disable directives.

must_not_change: Coverage must remain informational and not decide check exit codes.
Required uncovered files must be listed for adoption planning.
Disable directive totals must stay visible in coverage output.

contracts.intent: Scan local DriftLock disable directives so temporary adoption exceptions stay visible in coverage reporting.

must_not_change: Disable directives must be reporting-only until enforcement is explicit.
Malformed and expired directives must stay visible in coverage.
File paths must be normalized before directive scanning.

contracts.intent: Format stable Drift diagnostics so CLI, ESLint, CI, and agents receive consistent error codes, locations, and severity prefixes.

must_not_change: DRIFTxxx codes must remain stable and human-readable.
Diagnostic severity formatting must preserve info, warning, and error levels.
Error locations must include file and line when available.

contracts.intent: Convert current Drift violations into explanations that describe the expected behavior, observed drift, and actionable fix for humans and agents.

must_not_change: Explanations must derive from current check results.
SSOT flow explanations must include sink, reason, and suggested fix when available.
Empty explanation output must remain explicit.

contracts.intent: Extract valid @drift contracts from TypeScript source while reporting schema, duplicate-id, and anchoring errors deterministically.

must_not_change: Only real TypeScript comments may be interpreted as Drift contracts.
Contract extraction must continue collecting errors across files.
Contract ordering must remain deterministic for generated indexes.

contracts.intent: Discover configured TypeScript source files deterministically while respecting project ignores and normalized Drift source roots.

must_not_change: Discovery must ignore generated, dependency, git, and Drift metadata folders.
Source roots must support strings and arrays.
Returned file paths must stay sorted and project-relative.

contracts.intent: Resolve Git changed-file scope for Drift checks while expanding impacted contracts when declared sources of truth change.

must_not_change: Changed source files must define the extraction scope.
SSOT file changes must include impacted contract files.
Deleted files must scope the index without being extracted.

contracts.intent: Produce stable Drift contract hashes from canonical contract content and raw anchored body text.

must_not_change: Content hashes must ignore harmless YAML formatting noise.
Body hashes must preserve anchored implementation text changes.
Array order must remain authorial and hash-relevant.

contracts.intent: Read, write, and serialize the committed Drift contract index used as the baseline for locked contract checks.

must_not_change: Runtime-only extraction fields must not be written to the committed index.
Missing index files must be treated as absent, not invalid.
Generated indexes must remain stable pretty-printed JSON with a trailing newline.

contracts.intent: Generate equivalent TypeScript and NodeNext module specifier candidates for Drift SSOT usage and changed-file matching.

must_not_change: Extensionless candidates must be included.
TypeScript and emitted JavaScript extensions must map both directions.
Candidate order must remain deterministic.

contracts.intent: Validate supported declaration-scoped return flows so configured sinks derive from declared sources of truth.

must_not_change: Unsupported flow patterns must fail clearly instead of passing silently.
Return sinks must be explicit object paths.
Trusted values must originate from declared SSOT imports.

contracts.intent: Validate and normalize Drift contract schema objects before extraction, hashing, checking, or indexing can trust them.

must_not_change: Unknown fields must be rejected so ignored data cannot look enforceable.
Supported invariant schemas must stay strict.
Normalization must happen before contract hashing.

contracts.intent: Re-export the public DriftLock core API from a single stable package entrypoint.

must_not_change: Public core modules must remain reachable through the package root.
Types and executable helpers must stay exported together.

contracts.intent: Define the shared DriftLock schema, diagnostic, diff, and explanation types used across core, CLI, and ESLint packages.

must_not_change: Drift schema version 1 types must remain strict and explicit.
Diagnostic codes must stay stable for CLI, ESLint, and agent workflows.
Indexed contracts must omit runtime-only extraction fields.

contracts.intent: Publish the DriftLock ESLint plugin rule map and recommended flat-config preset under the drift-lock namespace.

must_not_change: The recommended preset must enable every exported rule as an error.
Rule names must stay stable for downstream ESLint configs.
The plugin object must reference itself in the recommended config.

contracts.intent: Report silent edits to locked Drift contracts by comparing the current file against the committed Drift index during ESLint runs.

must_not_change: Missing indexes must be ignored so projects can lint before extraction.
Invalid indexes must be reported as lint failures.
Locked-change checks must stay scoped to the linted file.

contracts.intent: Report Drift SSOT flow violations through ESLint for contracts extracted from the file currently being linted.

must_not_change: The rule must only evaluate contracts extracted from the current file.
Every SSOT flow error must be forwarded through the shared reporter.

contracts.intent: Report Drift SSOT usage violations through ESLint for contracts extracted from the file currently being linted.

must_not_change: The rule must only evaluate contracts extracted from the current file.
Every SSOT usage error must be forwarded through the shared reporter.

contracts.intent: Report Drift contract syntax, schema, and anchoring errors through ESLint for the file currently being linted.

must_not_change: The rule must report every extractor error for the current file.
Filenames must be normalized relative to the configured root.

contracts.intent: Share ESLint rule helpers for DriftLock root resolution, config index lookup, normalized filenames, and diagnostic reporting.

must_not_change: Rules must normalize filenames relative to the configured root.
ESLint reporting must preserve Drift diagnostic messages and locations.
Missing config must keep the default generated index path.
